dict.string: SupremeNotch shows the battery level of your AirPods when they connect.
SupremeNotch reads your calendar to remind you in the notch shortly before a meeting starts. It never changes events.

SupremeNotch watches your Downloads folder to show a short notice when a download finishes.

SupremeNotch listens only while you dictate a question in the Ask tab. By default the recording goes to ChatGPT for transcription, using your Codex sign-in. To keep it on this Mac, set Dictation to On this Mac in Settings.
Used only when Dictation is set to On this Mac in Settings: SupremeNotch turns what you dictate in the Ask tab into text without it leaving this Mac.
